Class Tensor<E>

edu.odu.cs.cs361.Tensor<E>

public class Tensor<E> extends Object implements Cloneable, Iterable<TensorEntry<E>>

    • get

      public E get(int... index) throws IncorrectArity
      Retrieve a value from a tensor, given indices as explicit parameters or an an array of int.
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the desired value. Can be passed as a sequence of int parameters or as an array.
      Returns:
      the value, or None if no value has been assigned, implicitly or explicitly, to that location
      Throws:
      IncorrectArity - if the number of indices is inappropriate to the tensor
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if an index is negative or, for some tensors, too large

    • assign

      public void assign(E value, int... index) throws IncorrectArity
      Assign a value to an indexed position.
      Parameters:
      value - value to assign
      index - position, expressed as a list of int parameters or an int array
      Throws:
      IncorrectArity - if the number of indices does not match the declaration of the tensor

    • iterator

      public Iterator<TensorEntry<E>> iterator()
      Provide an iterator over entries in the tensor that are not equal to the initial/default value. What constitutes an "explicitly assigned" depends on the backing store.
      Specified by:
      iterator in interface Iterable<E>
      See Also:
      • Iterable.iterator()

    • slice

      public Tensor<E> slice(int index, int start, int width)
      Provide a tensor, based upon this one, in which one or more of the indices have been remapped to a potentially smaller range.
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the dimension to fix
      start - the first index value in that dimension be selected
      width - the number of index values in that dimension to select
      Returns:
      a reduced-size tensor

    • select

      public Tensor<E> select(int dimension, int value)
      Provide a tensor, based upon this one, in which one of the dimensions has been fixed to a single index value, resulting in a lower arity tensor with a subset of the entries in this one.
      Parameters:
      dimension - the dimension to fix
      value - the value to fix the index of that dimension to
      Returns:
      a reduced-arity tensor
